audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction in this matchup is absent: Infinite Duress (R) is a channel, so Shadow Dash's taunt cancels it outright. The page instead says the suppression 'bypasses your taunt', which teaches the opposite behaviour — spending E early instead of holding it for his leap.
audit.why: Riot flags Warwick's R as channel plus hardCC; Shen's E applies hard CC. Any CC cancels a channel. Holding E for his R turns his only all-in into a wasted 110-second cooldown.
audit.corrected: Hold Shadow Dash for his leap — your taunt cancels Infinite Duress and strands him on a 110-second cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing warns that Primal Howl (E, 15/14/13/12/11s, 375 range) fears — and therefore cancels your Stand United channel. Infinite Duress can do the same.
audit.why: Shen's R is a 200/180/160s interruptible channel. Warwick has a 15-second answer to it and the page never says so.
audit.corrected: Never start Stand United inside Primal Howl's 375 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: mid tells the player to memorize Infinite Duress's 'roughly 100-second cooldown'.
audit.why: Real values are 110/90/70. At the level 6 timing the text is describing, it is 110 — ten seconds of extra safety the page throws away by rounding to a number that is not a rank value at all.
audit.corrected: 110 seconds at rank 1, 90 at rank 2, 70 at rank 3.

audit.why: Both layers agree (Skill/Shen/Shen/Skill/Skill/Shen/Shen). Warwick has no dash outside Q's short lunge and no escape from Shadow Dash, so Shen genuinely owns levels 2-3; the Skill rows at 4-6 track Warwick's R and stat growth.

Four spikes present and correctly ordered: Lvl 2 (Shadow Dash), Lvl 3 (full pattern), Lvl 6 (his R / your R), 1st item. Anti-heal is correctly named as core given Eternal Hunger, Jaws of the Beast and Infinite Duress all heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].t frames the answer to Warwick as anti-heal alone.
audit.why: Jaws of the Beast is flagged percentHealth — it scales off your maximum health, so a pure HP-stacking Shen makes Warwick's Q hit harder. Anti-heal plus resistances is the answer, not raw HP.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal his Q and do not answer him with pure HP.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 the pattern is the same but his durability is growing — keep the wave on your side of the river so he has to walk into your engage rather than the reverse, and freeze if you have a lead to deny him gold and XP. At Level 6 everything changes in your favor on the map: his Infinite Duress is his only real threat, so memorize its roughly 100-second cooldown, trade aggressively when it is down, and the moment a bot or mid skirmish appears with a low ally Stand United and leave — a Warwick who can only push top while you TP into a 2v2 bot is a losing Warwick.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 the pattern is the same but his durability is growing — keep the wave on your side of the river so he has to walk into your engage rather than the reverse, and freeze if you have a lead to deny him gold and XP. At Level 6 his Infinite Duress is the only real threat, and it is a channel — hold Shadow Dash for his leap and your taunt cancels the suppression outright. Its cooldown is 110 seconds at rank 1, so trade freely when it is down, and the moment a bot or mid skirmish appears with a low ally Stand United and leave — a Warwick who can only push top while you TP into a 2v2 bot is a losing Warwick.

edits.before: Warwick's Infinite Duress comes online — it suppresses you through the taunt, so track its cooldown like a timer; outside that window Stand United lets you abandon the lane and convert pressure globally.
edits.after: Warwick's Infinite Duress comes online — a 1.5s suppress on a 110s cooldown, but it is a channel your Shadow Dash cancels; outside that window Stand United lets you abandon the lane and convert globally.

edits.before: Save Infinite Duress for when you overextend without Flash — the suppression bypasses your taunt and lets him deal full auto damage freely
edits.after: Save Infinite Duress for when you overextend without Flash — land it before your taunt can answer, because your E cancels the leap outright
Anti-heal his Q, don't just stack HP

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Primal Howl's fear cancels Stand United — channel outside 375 range.

notes: All three packet suspectNames ('Save Infinite Duress', "Twilight Assault's", "Stand United's") are FALSE POSITIVES — every name matches the kits. The genuine defect the packet missed is a reversed mechanic: the page claimed Infinite Duress 'bypasses your taunt' when in fact Shen's taunt cancels the channel. That is the highest-value correction in this matchup.
